rnea_compensator_config._comment: LEFT HAND RNEA (single-body Newton-Euler) dynamic compensator config. Consumed by third_party/bota_demo_py rnea_core.RneaCompensatorConfig.from_json via the UMI SensorReader RNEA adapter. NOTE: UMI's FtChain already transports the IMU to the SENSOR ORIGIN before packing the 12-vector, so the adapter OVERRIDES geometry.imu_offset to [0,0,0] at runtime (the offset below is the physically-correct standalone value, kept for documentation / standalone bota_demo_py use). mass/com/inertia = AVERAGE of 3 Bota estimator runs; a Recompensation on this hand overwrites them. wrench_sign was calibrated on hardware for the left hand.

geometry._comment: sensor-origin -> IMU point [m], SENSOR axes. STANDALONE value; the UMI adapter zeroes this because the 12-vector IMU is already at the sensor origin (see _comment).

conventions._comment: accel_is_specific_force MUST be true. wrench_sign = -1 calibrated on the LEFT hand (Bota reads opposite sign to prediction). wrench_sign_verified is a UMI-only marker (ignored by rnea_core) the viz reads to warn about unverified hands.
